snippet.title: MFL2  Indie Horror Showcase
snippet.description:
Mutant Football League 2 blitzes DreadXP’s Indie Horror Showcase with this new trailer.

Mutant Football League 2 is coming in hot on December 10, 2025, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows PC via Steam. MFL2 is the over-the-top "anti-Madden" successor to the 2017 Mutant Football League by Michael Mendheim, the mind behind Electronic Arts’ ‘90s Sega Genesis hits like Mutant League Football and Mutant League Hockey.

This is not your parents’ football game or a bloated simulation that chases realism at the expense of fun. Mutant Football League 2 is a brutal, darkly comedic 8-on-8 arcade-style action-packed football game. Teams of Mutated Super-Humans, Monstrous Orcs, Skeletal Deadheads, and Armored BruiserBots are pit against each other in fantastical arenas packed with deadly traps and sinister hazards like buzzsaws and giant mutant worms. This “anti-Madden” blends the pick-up-and-play accessibility of arcade sports games with strategic depth and a buttload of monstrous mayhem.

Buy Mutant Football League 2 now: 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1657320/Mutant_Football_League_2/  
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010031 
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p72ljj5srx0  

Follow and subscribe for more updates, highlights, and behind-the-scenes content. 

Credits: 
Director / Editor: Anastasiya Danylchenko - BANG-BANG!!! Production 
Technical: Ivan Zaplava 
Voice Over: Tim Kitzrow 
Audio: Brian Schmidt 
Producer: Michael Mendheim 
Song: “What’s Past is Prologue” by Sea of Treachery” (Courtesy of Mutant League Records, LLC)
